items.customer_text: 一坐低做嘢就幾個鐘嘅話，去斟嘢飲嗰陣企直行一陣先啦。
items.internal_reason: Turns a normal drink break into one effortless movement cue; concise, personal and distinct from recent stretch-focused wording.

items.customer_text: 出門口先醒起未飲過水？飲幾啖先走啦，唔使急嗰十秒。
items.internal_reason: A familiar rushed-morning moment with one gentle hydration action; warm and conversational without sounding like a health notice.

items.customer_text: 今日操到中段如果開始亂晒節奏，停一停抖順條氣先再做。
items.internal_reason: Useful mid-session breathing cue rather than another warm-up or weight reminder, with one clear action and natural gym Cantonese.

items.customer_text: 打字打到對手一路吊住嘅話，放低膊頭先啦，唔使成日提住。
items.internal_reason: Specific desk-posture observation that feels noticed rather than taught, avoiding recent phone/head-forward phrasing.

items.customer_text: 今晚如果仲覺得成個人攰攰哋，早少少收工休息都得，唔使樣樣做齊先肯停。
items.internal_reason: Recovery message framed around everyday overdoing rather than training numbers, giving a human permission-to-rest tone without medical claims.
